title: argus run --dry-run shows the kind of every step

python.note: Defect in argus/cli.py: the dry-run line is printed as rich markup, so the '[step]'/'[assert]'/'[teardown]' kind tag is swallowed as a style tag and the step kind never reaches the output. The same markup handling mangles spec errors that contain '[' (for example an invalid YAML flow sequence). Python line receives critical fixes only (R-7); fix in the Rust line.

rust.note: argus-next implements only --help and --version in P0; commands arrive in later phases (spec section 12)

files.content:
provider: ollama
providers:
  ollama:
    model: conformance-model
    base_url: http://127.0.0.1:9
budgets:
  time_minutes: 1

name: Conformance smoke
target:
  adapter: cli
  launch: echo conformance
steps:
  - "Run the command and read its output"
  - assert:
      stdout_contains: "conformance"
  - assert:
      exit_code_is: 0
